discussion_comments.comment_body: The 'Score' field in the JSON schema should be optional, as not all PRs may require a score. Consider adding a 'required' attribute to the 'Score' field and set it to false. [medium]

discussion_comments.comment_body:
Good point. This is why I waited for #223 to be merged :)  
With it, the describe command is less destructive by default. We can make it even less destructive by using `describe --pr_description.add_original_user_description=true --pr_description.keep_original_user_title=true` to force it to always be the least destructive as possible, regardless of what the user has set up in their `configuration.toml`.  
But if you think it's still not enough I will remove it from the list completely and keep only `auto_review`.
